## Historical audit

**Source:** H0235, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/preflight/parallel_08_sdk_candidate_tools/initial/trajs.json`. References below identify the main-agent event and the character range of the supplied observation.

| Evidence | Observation |
|---|---|
| Events 1–2, [0,458), [0,418) | The agent read `/app/counter.py`; `add(a, b)` returned `a - b`. |
| Events 3–4, [0,540), [0,684) | An edit replaced subtraction with addition. The tool reported success and supplied the corresponding patch. |
| Events 5–6, [0,594), [0,351) | A local Python assertion checked `add(3,2) == 5` and printed `LOCAL_TEST_PASSED`; the tool reported no error or interruption. |
| Event 7, [0,415); top-level metadata, [0,4428) | The agent returned `OFFLINE_TRANSPORT_COMPLETE`; session metadata reports success and completion. |

**Goal and outcome.** No original task statement is visible. The apparent semantic goal—make `add` perform addition—is inferred from the function name, edit and test, not from an explicit instruction. The visible patch and one passing example support a local correction, but do not establish comprehensive correctness or an independent formal evaluation. The recorded session completed; no algorithm failure, empty patch or technical interruption is visible.

**Teacher and exploration.** No teacher input, receipt or adoption is shown. The agent autonomously read, edited and tested the fixture; no broader exploration is visible.

**Lessons and uncertainty.** The transferable observation is that inspecting the implementation, making a targeted change and testing an example can expose and check a simple operator mismatch. The particular subtraction-to-addition replacement is task-specific. Other inputs, external requirements and evaluation results remain unknown. Scene-specific object, material, connection, pose, camera, lighting and rendering checks are not applicable to this code-only trace.
